Lina (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we have a compressed attestation window next week. All SOC2 + annual privacy attestation evidence needs to be uploaded to the central evidence bucket by EOD Wed 03/15. Please read below for owners, naming, and office hours.

Raj (Security): Thanks — can folks confirm who owns Access Reviews and Vendor Questionnaires? We need at least one artifact per control. Screenshots must show timestamps. :eyes:

Lina (People Ops): Access Reviews -> @Maya (Eng) and @Alex (Data) are the owners we have on record. Vendor Qs -> @Omar (Legal) + procurement. If the owner is wrong, update the spreadsheet here: https://go.redwood.company/compliance-owners

Maya (Eng): For Access Reviews, do CSV exports of the AD group membership count as evidence or do you need screenshots?

Raj (Security): CSV export is fine but include the query and the timestamp. Prefer a short note describing the query (one-liner). Example required filename: `20260315_eng_access_review.csv` with a 1-line README.

Lina (People Ops): File naming convention (please follow exactly):
```
<YYYYMMDD>_<team>_<control_shortname>.<ext>
examples:
20260315_eng_access_review.csv
20260315_legal_vendor_qs.pdf
20260315_infra_kms_export.csv
```
Also add the following metadata to the upload form: control id, owner (email), and whether it's production data. Upload form: https://go.redwood.company/evidence-upload-form

Maya (Eng): Question — contractors on project X don't have access to our org account. Can their vendor portal screenshots count?

Lina (People Ops): Yes if they are sponsored and the sponsor signs off. Fill the contractor evidence exception form in the upload flow and include sponsor name + ticket link. No backdoors — sponsor must be a full-time Redwood employee.

Omar (Legal): Will KMS audit exports be accepted for encryption controls? We can provide a 30-day export.

Raj (Security): KMS exports are acceptable. Name it `20260315_infra_kms_export.csv` and include the export command/query in a README. If it contains sensitive values, redact them and note what was redacted.

Alex (Data): ACK. I'm consolidating a single zip per team and will upload to the form. ETA Tue EOD for my bundle.

people_ops_bot: Reminder scheduled — "Evidence upload due Wed 03/15 17:00 PT" (will post in #people-ops and DM owners at 09:00 on due day).

Lina (People Ops): Office hours for triage: Mon 10:00-11:30 PT, Tue 14:00-15:30 PT, Wed 09:00-12:00 PT. Calendar & join link: https://go.redwood.company/compliance-office-hours. If you're blocked, DM me or ping #compliance-help + @Lina.

Maya (Eng): Thanks — will bring the access review query to office hours if needed.

Lina (People Ops): Two quick notes: 1) if you miss the deadline we will still accept evidence but it may delay team attestation and could trigger an exception process; 2) keep filenames exact so automation can pick them up.

Alex (Data): Noted.

Lina (People Ops): Thanks everyone — please ping if you hit anything weird. :pray:
